name: Lugh, Phoenix of Radiant Skill
description:
Forged at the edge of sun and steel, Lugh rises as the avian sovereign of craft and war — every line of his body marked by red Celtic spirals pulsing with inner golden light. His spear Gae Assail is not merely a weapon but the axis through which he channels precision, discipline, and mastery sharp enough to pierce any darkness.

Behind him burns a crown of solar fire against the void, yet he alone stands as the source of order and radiance. In his measured stride there is no doubt — only perfected skill and divine responsibility in every strike.

attributes.value: God of Light, Skill and War
Athletic avian physique with metallic feathers (bronze, gold, steel)
Glowing red Celtic spiral tattoos across chest and arms
Phoenix visage with flowing silver-golden hair
Four clawed fingers on each hand, gripping spear firmly
Broad metallic wings with golden highlights
Green and bronze tartan wrap with Celtic knot patterns
Bronze armbands and sun-disc pauldron with spiral engravings
Gae Assail — divine spear with runic shaft and white-gold tip
Radiant solar corona behind the head
Dynamic, spear held diagonally in controlled readiness
Golden rimlight and rune glow against black void
Pure black with lower area reserved for banner
